files.listing.md:
6'2" shortboard, 29 L, fins included

Price: $320
Condition: Good, used for three summers.

A lively 6'2" thruster at 29 litres. Fins are included and it is ready to surf.

There is one repaired ding on the left rail. A shaper did the repair and it is watertight. No other dings, just the normal pressure marks on the deck.

Pickup from Maroubra. Cash or bank transfer on collection.
